name: Dheepika

copy: Every flower here holds a little of us.

lanternWishes: Courage on the days you need it.
Rest on the days you don’t.
People who see you the way I do.
A year that is gentle with you.
Late talks that end in laughter.
Someone always saving you the window seat.
Me, still beside you, a year from now.
finalWords: Another year of memories waiting to happen.
futurePrompt: Write something we should read together next year.

beginning.line: The day my favourite person entered this world.

memories.caption: One of the days I keep replaying.
I didn’t know then how much this would matter.
Your laugh, right before this was taken.
Proof that ordinary days with you are the best ones.
I remember exactly how this moment felt.
You, being completely yourself. My favourite view.
A small moment that turned into a big memory.
If I could live one day again, it might be this one.

puzzle.caption: Some pieces only make sense together. Like us.

paragraphs: There are things I think about you every day and somehow never say out loud. So I built you a garden, and I’m saying them here.
You make ordinary days feel like something worth remembering. You make me laugh when I least expect it, you listen when I don’t make sense, and you stay kind even when the world isn’t.
I don’t know everything this year will bring. But I know I want to be there for the good days and the hard ones, for the small plans and the big dreams, for all of it.
Thank you for being exactly who you are. I wouldn’t change a single thing, except maybe how many birthdays I get to spend with you. More, please.

reasons: Your smile: it changes the whole room, and it still catches me off guard.
Your laugh: it’s my favourite sound, and I’ll do silly things just to hear it.
Your kindness: you’re gentle with people even when nobody is watching.
Your angry face: honestly, it’s too cute to take seriously, and you know it.
Your craziness: life with you is never boring, not even for a minute.
Your voice: some days, it’s the only thing that makes everything feel okay.
The way you support me: you believe in me on days I don’t believe in myself.
Your little habits: the small things you do without noticing are the ones I notice most.
Your honesty: you tell me the truth, even when a softer answer would be easier.
Your strength: you carry more than you let anyone see, and you still show up.
Your curiosity: you make me want to see the world with new eyes.
Your heart: the way you care, fully and without holding back.
The way you say my name: somehow it sounds different when you say it.
Simply you: all of you, exactly as you are. That’s the fourteenth reason and the first.
nameLetters: D is for the Dreams I want to chase with you.
H is for the way you make anywhere feel like Home.
E is for Every day I choose you, again.
E is for Endless talks that never feel long enough.
P is for the Patience you show me more than I deserve.
I is for the Inside jokes nobody else will ever get.
K is for your Kindness, the kind that changes people.
A is for Always, which is how long I mean all of this.

game.finish: But you already caught my heart.

quiz.q: What do I love doing with you most?
quiz.yes: Exactly. Anything, as long as it’s with you. 🥹
quiz.no: Close… but the real answer is: all of it.

quiz.q: When do I miss you the most?
quiz.no: That too. But honestly? Pretty much always.

quiz.q: What do you think I noticed first about you?
quiz.yes: Good guess. Ask me in person and I’ll tell you the whole story.
quiz.no: Good guess. Ask me in person and I’ll tell you the whole story.

secret.intro: Answer each clue to reveal one symbol of the code. Everything you need is somewhere in this little universe.

clues.clue: How many tulips grow in this garden? Only the first digit, please.
Count the tulips again. What is the last digit?
What shape holds the letter D on the very first screen?
In 25 · 11, which number is the month?
The month once more. What is its last digit?

reveal.text: 25 ♥ 11. The code was your birthday all along, because that’s the day everything good started.

timeline.label: Before Us
timeline.text: Two separate stories, not knowing yet that they were about to become one.

timeline.label: We Met
timeline.text: An ordinary day that turned out to be the most important one.

timeline.label: Getting Closer
timeline.text: Somewhere in the conversations and the small moments, you became my favourite person.

timeline.label: Us
timeline.text: The day I realised this was something I never wanted to lose.

timeline.label: Today
timeline.text: Here. Still choosing you, still amazed by you, still learning you.

timeline.label: What Comes Next
timeline.text: Everything we haven’t done yet. I can’t wait for all of it.

gifts.label: I
gifts.text: You are the best thing that has happened to me, and I don’t say it enough. So here it is, in a box, where you can find it any time.

gifts.label: II
gifts.text: I promise to listen, even when I think I already know. To show up, even on the hard days. And to keep making you laugh.

gifts.label: III
gifts.text: One whole day, planned entirely by you. Wherever, whatever. I’ll say yes to all of it.

wish.line: I hope this one comes true.

future.title: A place we should visit
future.text: Somewhere with a sky this full of stars.

future.title: Something we should try
future.text: Something neither of us has ever done, so we can be bad at it together.

future.title: A photo we haven't taken yet
future.text: The two of us, laughing too hard to look at the camera.

future.title: A midnight adventure
future.text: No plan, a full tank, and a playlist we both pretend to hate.

future.title: One dream for us
future.text: A life where every ordinary day still feels a little like this garden.

wishes: A year full of reasons to smile.
Mornings that start slow and soft.
Good news arriving when you least expect it.
Every plan you make working out.
Friends who feel like home.
A new place that steals your heart.
Health, rest, and gentle days.
Courage for every new beginning.
Laughter until your cheeks hurt.
Dreams that start coming true.
Quiet evenings that feel like a hug.
Music that finds you at the right moment.
Kindness coming back to you, tenfold.
Confidence in everything you are.
Adventures, big and small.
A reason to dance in the kitchen.
People who make you feel understood.
Peace on the difficult days.
Surprises that make you gasp.
Time for the things you love.
Growth that feels exciting, not heavy.
Moments you’ll want to remember forever.
Love that feels safe and easy.
And me, cheering for you through all of it.

movie.line: Different days. Different places. Same person I keep choosing.

finale.headline: Every flower here is yours.
finale.lastThing: If you’ve come all the way here, through the garden, past the cake and up into the sky, then you already know. But I’ll say it anyway. You are my favourite part of every day. Thank you for being born, and thank you for letting me be part of your story. Here’s to this year, and every one after it.
finale.secretEnding: You found every hidden heart. Of course you did: you notice the small things, the same way you noticed me. This is the last secret: every heart in this garden was always yours.
